name: fields_from_the_view
title: A table's fields come from world_query's fields view

steps.say: what fields does my Deals table have?
steps.reply:
Your Deals table (in Deal Tracker) has 5 fields:

| Field | Type |
|---|---|
| Business | Text |
| Asking price | Number, in £ |
| City | Text |
| Stage | Choice: Looking, Offer made, Closed |
| Broker email | Text |

None of them are required. The table has one deal in it so far.

arg.rubric: Passes if the answer lists the fields business, asking price (in £), city, stage (with its choices Looking, Offer made, Closed, or naming it a choice) and broker email, and nothing that isn't a field. Fails if it misses a field, invents one, or says it can't tell.
arg.facts: The Deals table (module Deal Tracker) has five fields: business (text), asking_price (number, £), city (text), stage (choice: Looking, Offer made, Closed), broker_email (text). It has one row, Harbour Car Wash.

checks.why: The answer lists all five fields (business, asking price in £, city, stage with its choices Looking/Offer made/Closed, and broker email), adds no extra fields, and agrees with what is true in the person's world.
